summary: @or-sdk/keys ships preinstall dropper that downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) unconditionally downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. `math_init.js` is an undeclared ~727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with javascript-obfuscator-style string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }` over a large numeric literal array). The file is not referenced by `main`/`module`/`types`, is not part of the `dist/` build output, and is not mentioned in README or CHANGELOG; its only entry point is the preinstall hook. The SDK sources in `dist/` and `src/` appear as an ordinary keys-API wrapper and have no legitimate need for a second language runtime. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: a Node-invoked preinstall fetches Bun specifically so that Node-focused static scanners will not analyze the executed payload. Installing this version causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code — the obfuscated Bun bundle — to run on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
